title: Release Floor for Property Tax Refund Excess When the Summit Loan Is Due and Payable
content:
**Applies to:** the kept amount of a returned property tax refund on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, where the reserve's Summit loan has a maturity case (Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases) that is due and payable or in its extension period.

**Rule.** The release floor for the excess is set by the intent recorded on that maturity case:

- Where the case records an intent to sell the property or to give a deed in lieu, the release floor is the leaving-home release floor, 0.00: any excess above zero is released.
- Where the case records an intent to retain the property, the release floor is the retaining release floor, 25.00.
- Where the case records no such intent, or the loan has no maturity case that is due and payable or in its extension period, this rule does not set the floor.

**Reading the floor.** An excess is released only when it is above zero and at least the floor; an excess below the floor stays in the reserve.

| Intent on the maturity case | Floor | Hypothetical excess 20.00 | Hypothetical excess 25.00 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sell the property | 0.00 | Released | Released |
| Deed in lieu | 0.00 | Released | Released |
| Retain the property | 25.00 | Stays in the reserve | Released |
